mechanism: Fenofibrate may increase chlorpromazine levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition and displacement from protein binding, while chlorpromazine may potentiate fenofibrate's lipid-lowering effects and increase photosensitivity risk.
action: Monitor for chlorpromazine toxicity signs (extrapyramidal effects, QT prolongation); consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; counsel on sun protection; adjust chlorpromazine dose if needed.
